svg.aria-label: The Create New Project dialog, simplified. It has three tabs: Configure Project, Assign Repositories and Add Destinations. The first tab asks for a project name, a project key, a storage quota, the privileges granted to Project Admins, and who the Project Admins are. Five callouts: the project key is permanent; the quota is a signal on SaaS; privileges decide how much is delegated; name the Project Admins; then click Create.
